Environmental activist Erin Brockovich is leading a national campaign against the secretive boom of AI data centers by launching a crowdsourced reporting platform and interactive map to track operational, under-construction, and proposed facilities across the United States.
Her primary actions and initiatives include:
Mapping & Database Initiative: She launched the U.S. AI Data Center Reporting website, which allows local residents to log facility locations and submit firsthand observations. The database has already collected thousands of complaints across 49 states.
Pushing for Transparency: She is actively calling out Big Tech developers and local officials for pushing massive projects through with "back-door deals" and nondisclosure agreements (NDAs) before neighboring communities are even made aware.
Highlighting Environmental & Community Tolls: She is aggregating data and raising public awareness on the severe local impacts of these facilities, including massive daily water consumption (up to 5 million gallons per day per facility) that drains aquifers and well water, escalating utility bills for local residents, electronic waste, and constant 24/7 noise pollution affecting human and animal health.
